title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12756)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12756) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12756). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 2962-1984 Cheese and processed cheese products — Determination of total phosphorus content — Molecular absorption spectrometric method', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Sectional Committee ( AFDC 34 ) and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. In the adopted standard, certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'; and b) Comma (,) has been used as decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
